values.value: Zero NetPrice with positive Qty + ListPrice
SELECT Id, Name FROM SBQQ__QuoteLine__c WHERE SBQQ__Quantity__c > 0 AND SBQQ__ListPrice__c > 0 AND (SBQQ__NetPrice__c = null OR SBQQ__NetPrice__c = 0)
Quote line "{Name}" has $0 NetPrice on positive Qty + ListPrice
Quote line has Quantity > 0 and ListPrice > 0 but NetPrice is $0 or null. Likely revenue leakage from a misconfigured price rule or manual override.

Finds: SBQQ__QuoteLine__c records where Quantity > 0 and ListPrice > 0 but NetPrice is null or zero. Why it matters: Lines that should price but don't represent direct revenue leakage — the customer gets the product for free. Usually caused by a misconfigured price rule or QCP override that zeroed the field. Suppress a finding: when the $0 is genuinely intentional (free trial line, gifted add-on). Disable the detector: only if $0 lines are normal. Most should leave this on.
